fusions.name: Crop-Stripping Arc
fusions.desc: Strips everything within 4 tiles with the lash for 26 damage that always lands as a critical hit, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Chewing Snaps
fusions.desc: A gnawing snap deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Loosed Swarm
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash and looses a devouring swarm for 10 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage.

fusions.name: Gorge and Move On
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
